sources.title: G4.5 C2 Common Brush Processing & Output Fanout Architecture v0.2
G4.5 C2 P16 Runtime Data Flow & Thread Model v0.1

accepted_claims: R1 perfect-freehand one-shot geometry parity accepted
reference evaluator remains available as oracle

trusted_statements: C2 owns common Brush processing after C0 routes input as Ink.
Arc and canonical Runtime split only after renderer-neutral Brush output.
C1 to C0 to C2 stays logically synchronous and ordered through BrushPreviewDeltaReady.
The first intended async boundary is after BrushPreviewDeltaReady.
Preview handoff is bounded and may latest-win only for superseded non-terminal revisions.
Terminal cancel and retire semantics are reliable and non-droppable.
BrushCommitIntent is confirmed-only reliable non-droppable and never latest-wins.
Canonical congestion must not block move-time preview generation.
Final preview retires only after a matching CanonicalVisible receipt.
The R1 one-shot perfect-freehand evaluator remains the correctness oracle.
The hot preview evaluator must not re-evaluate full stroke history on every append.
Web and Android platform-local BrushRuntime ownership and Windows raw-pointer preview derivation are C2 migration debt.
C2 does not redesign Arc renderer presenter backend selection or canonical semantic schema.
C2 successor is D0 Dear ImGui Common UI Foundation.
